title: Q-SPEC-21-social-through-guard: route the platform's own social publisher through the one outbound guard (US-21-R06, R14)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** specification audit 2026-11-26: the row is PLANNED in the status table of specs/US-SPEC-21-capability-packs.md
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -qE "createGuard|guard\.send" -- seed/worker/src/social.js
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-21 says every outbound action passes `guard.send` and that the guard is the same code for every pack and platform. The pack host does this (`workers/core/packs/guard.js`). The platform's own publisher, `seed/worker/src/social.js`, enforces its own kill switch, caps and paused channels from `social/gate.json` and reads each post back, but it is a second door out: no shared ledger of refusals, no idempotency key shared with packs, no suppression list. Vendor the guard into the seed the way other core modules are vendored (`doctrine/tenant-repos.json`), call it from the publisher with the gate file as its switches and caps, and keep the read-back. The existing tests of the publisher must pass unchanged.

**Closing probe:** `node --test --no-warnings seed/worker/test/social-connect.test.js seed/worker/test/promoqueue.test.js`
**Prediction:** spec21_planned_rows <= 0 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** weakening the gate file's kill switch or caps; a second copy of the guard edited by hand in the seed; posting from any account that is not already connected.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
